flows.title: Upload files or a folder
steps: At the top left, click New, then File upload or Folder upload.
Choose the file or folder to upload. Dragging files into an open Drive folder uploads them too.

flows.title: Create a folder or move a file into one
steps: To create a folder: on the left, click New, then Folder. Enter a name and click Create.
To move a file: right-click it and click Organize, then Move.
Select or create the folder, then click Move.

flows.title: Share a file
steps: Go to Google Drive and select the file to share, then click Share.
Enter the email address to share with.
Choose how they can use the file: Viewer, Commenter or Editor.
Click Send or Share. Each email address gets an email.
